card.line: Bethel, once called Luz, was a city in Canaan where Jacob met God in a dream and named the place "house of God."

moments.title: Jacob's dream
moments.text: On his way to Haran, Jacob dreamed of a ladder reaching to heaven, and the LORD promised him land and descendants. Jacob named the place Bethel, which had been called Luz.

moments.title: Jacob returns to Bethel
moments.text: God told Jacob to go up to Bethel and build an altar. Jacob had his household put away foreign gods, then built the altar there and called the place El-bethel.

moments.title: Israel weeps and asks God
moments.text: In the war against Benjamin, the Israelites went up to Bethel to ask God who should fight first. After a hard defeat, they wept, fasted, and offered sacrifices there, and the LORD told them to fight.

moments.title: Jeroboam's golden calf
moments.text: King Jeroboam made two golden calves and set one up in Bethel. He also ordained a feast, made offerings on an altar there, and appointed priests for the high places.

moments.title: A man of God speaks against the altar
moments.text: A man of God from Judah came to Bethel by the LORD's word and cried out against Jeroboam's altar. When the king reached out to seize him, the king's hand withered, and the altar split apart.
